utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know if you hear anything, and I’ll keep the plan simple from here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check in if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick hand sorting donations and loading boxes would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with sorting and loading boxes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and whether we’ve got everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, it’s still on for now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to help with that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few staples and some tape — I’ve got a short list, if you want to grab what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I can grab those. Send me the list and I’ll head out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard the details yet—what exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s for the broken fence and maybe a few porch steps, and the drive should be sometime this weekend. I’m a little fuzzy on the exact time, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — could you check the exact time and which repairs they want done? I’d like to make sure I’ve got it right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here — what do you need me to help with on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — glad you made it. Could you help sort tools and direct folks to whichever repairs need an extra hand?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can sort the tools and point people where they’re needed. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and a couple extension cords? If you’ve got time, help me sort the tool table when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll bring my drill and a couple extension cords, and I can help sort the tool table too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure where the repair drive is set up yet, but I can keep an eye out and let you know as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’d really appreciate that. I need to plan around the school pickup, so just let me know when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll watch for it and tell you as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard the repair drive’s coming along nicely—folks have been dropping off a lot already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess—that’d be great. I’ll keep passing the word around and nudge folks to bring anything they can use.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll let you know if I hear of any gaps or urgent needs. You keep spreading the word, and we’ll get this thing over the finish line.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we know what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can check with a couple neighbors and see what’s still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you ask them and let me know what the top priorities are?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and keep reminding folks about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep nudging folks and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Uli — I’ve got the repair drive notes together and I’m ready to help organize the next steps. What would you like me to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Could you start by listing the biggest repair needs and who’s already offered to help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll pull together the biggest repair needs and match them with the folks who’ve already offered to help. I’ll send you a clear list soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout this time—folks seem ready to pitch in. If you’re going, I’d head over early so you don’t miss the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll get there early, then. I like having a clear plan, and it sounds like this one will be busy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the spirit—early birds get the best seats and the least chaos. If you want, I can point you to the volunteer table when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, I’m a bit late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s going pretty well — I’m still helping folks with their repairs, and I’ll keep at it for a bit longer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it — I can jump in and help for a bit if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What do you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. It’s just a few small things around the place—I'll make a short list for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, send it over when you’re ready and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just bring the repair drive itself and any cable you used with it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the repair drive and the cable I used with it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you help sort donations by type and check if we need any extra tools? I want to make sure we’re covering the basics before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can sort the donations by type and check our tool list for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly the timing and a few volunteers—we’re still on for the repair drive, just sorting the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I probably missed the update. What time are we aiming for now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’m keeping an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping watch. If you spot anything for the repair drive, let me know and I can bring over tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful. I’m headed back out now, so I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the tools and move the donation boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the tools and help move the donation boxes. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I want to make sure the timing and pickup details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time works best for you, and where should I arrange the pickup?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Afternoon would be safest for me, maybe around 3 PM. If you can pick up near my front gate, that should keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word fast — when’s the repair drive happening, and what can I tell people to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s this Saturday morning at the community lot. Tell folks to bring gloves, basic tools if they have them, and any spare parts they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll get that out right away and tell everyone to bring gloves, basic tools, and any spare parts they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule — what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I should know that, shouldn’t I? I’m pretty sure it starts in the late afternoon, but let me double-check so I don’t send you the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — just let me know the exact time when you check.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to check in. Is there anything on your block that needs attention first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard a few second-hand mentions, but the streetlight by the corner has been acting up. If you’re making a list, that might be the first thing to check.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll put the corner streetlight at the top of the list and have it checked first.
